gpu_tip: ~8GB total at 128K context — the smallest Ornith 1.5 9B build, sized to fit an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) end to end. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit on a model this small; prefer IQ3_M or Q3_K_L whenever the memory is there.
mac_tip: Needs ~8GB — fits a 16GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) comfortably.
